thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm reworking the Dedicated Capacity runbook to make SLA boundaries and the tenant isolation matrix clearer. Opening a PR now, need UX + eng eyes for wording and examples.

liam: Thanks — can you include a minimal YAML example that shows tenant labels + scale policy? That helps folks copy/paste.

maya: Yep, adding one now:
```yaml
tenant:
  id: acme-corp
  labels: [high-priority, compliance]
scalePolicy:
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 50
  cooldownSeconds: 300
isolation:
  preemption: false
  reservedPool: true
```

sam: Nit: our SDK uses `cooldown` (seconds) in the API, not `cooldownSeconds`. Also we should show a tiny SDK snippet linking to examples.

maya: Good catch, will change. Where should the SDK snippet live? docs/examples/dedicated?

priscilla: Put it under docs/examples/dedicated/tenant-labels.md and reference it from the runbook. I can author a small JS snippet for the SDK.

liam: I'll review the YAML + wording later today. Tagging @yuki for isolation policy language (preemption/reserved pool phrasing).

yuki: I'll take the isolation bit. Proposal: add a small table clarifying behavior by customer tier (Committed vs Best-effort) and an example for preemption semantics. Also suggest we define "Committed latency" vs "Best-effort latency" in the SLA section.

sam: Adding example SLA rows would help — e.g., "Committed: p95 < 200ms for up to X qps; Best-effort: best-effort p95 under load". Keep them illustrative, not contractual.

maya: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — Dedicated runbook: SLA/Isolation wording + examples. PTAL and leave inline comments.

docs-bot: PR opened by maya: PR #789 — \"Dedicated runbook SLA & isolation clarifications\". Requested reviewers: liam, priscilla.

liam: Left a few inline comments. One stale link: the runbook references `provisioning-cli` at /old/path — should point to /docs/cli/provisioning.md instead.

maya: Fixed the link, pushed an updated commit. Also added a short "rollback from shared to dedicated" subsection that outlines steps and caveats.

priscilla: I pushed the initial JS SDK example as a follow-up commit to the PR. It shows how to set tenant labels and call the dedicated provision endpoint.

yuki: Editorial note: for UX examples aimed at product teams, prefer the term "workspace" in the copy, but keep "tenant" in internal API examples. Add a callout explaining the terminology difference.

maya: Good call — added a callout block explaining the "workspace/tenant" naming mismatch.

sam: LGTM pending docs CI. @docs-bot can you trigger the preview build?

docs-bot: Triggered docs preview for PR #789 — https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-789 — build status: queued.

liam: :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks all — will merge once CI + two approvals are in. If anyone spots wording that changes customer expectations around SLAs, flag it here before merge.
